WitchboardX v1.37 supports 11 stereo channels with 234 parameters, trigger ducking, Main lookahead, Bypass Offset alignment, and the locked sidechain/filter defaults.

**Requires disting NT v1.19 beta**, currently available only via Discord, because cold code and preset serialisation use DRAM.

Download **release.zip** for the plugin, installation instructions, preset converter and aligned WitchboardX example preset. The example's samples and external hardware are not included. Copy `programs/plug-ins/WitchboardX.o` to the same path on the MicroSD card.

Existing v1.34 presets retain their saved values. Older layouts need the included converter. Four-rate routing/DSP/preset tests and ARM object checks passed; eleven-channel on-device loading remains to be verified.
